work.title: Untitled (Framed Diptych Collages)
work.description: Gallery photograph documenting two large framed collages hung side by side on a grey wall. Left panel features ivory ground with target rings, compact discs, football, yellow verticals, and black accumulations; right panel introduces red and green grounds with concentric-ring clusters, photographic silhouettes, and visible fabric lettering reading 'Funk'.
work.composition: two vertically oriented framed works side by side
